featured_reviews.name: Dhriti Vyas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Get to know about this library step by step:

1. If you are looking for a quite place and a good environment to study, than this is the perfect place to study at.

2. There are 2 study rooms one for boys and another for girls, girls sit on 2 floor and boys on 3 floor.

3. The study room is not that huge but neither that small there is no fixed place, you have to sit wherever you get seat, fully air-conditioned rooms, they provide charging points and lockers too

4. They have maintained a good hygiene in the study room as well as washroom. You can even get tea to drink it costs only 5 ruppes. You can bring food to eat but please maintain cleanliness.

5. To take addmission there, you required few documents like: aadhar card copy, 2 passport size photo, school/college fees receipt, residence proof if you have your own home or police NOC/aggreement copy if you live on rent. They will give you a form to fill up and it is need to be filled in Marathi. To take addmission vist on Monday to Friday and timings is 10am to 2:30 or 3pm.
The fees is 125 and with locker it is 185. Vaild for a year

These are the basic things you need to know about this library before joining, else you can ask to the staff or the lady sitting outside the room ( girls section ) they are friendly and answerable.

I hope this helps, thank you and have a nice day.

featured_reviews.name: Nitesh Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Last year, in June 2024, I bought my TYBCom textbooks from Ujwal Book Depot in Bhayandar East. At that time, they told me I would get 40% of the amount refunded if I returned the books in June 2025. Now, in June 2025, I went back with my books, which are in perfect condition, but their shop is closed. Their landline is dead, the number listed on Google Maps doesn’t work, and they don’t even bother to pick up the phone. So basically, they aren’t following the procedure they promised at all!

And last year, when I asked them for a Direct Tax book for 2024, they gave me a 2023 edition, claiming it was “new.” I didn’t realize it at first, but when I showed it to my teacher, she pointed out it was the wrong edition. When I went back to return it, they started arguing, saying, “You only asked for a new book, not a specific year.” What kind of nonsense is that? Just because a student asks for a new book, does that give them the right to hand over an outdated edition? Their attitude and behavior were pathetic — they don’t even know how to talk to customers properly. Worst experience ever!
Last year bhi aisa he experience tha yeh saal bhi,bhot bekar behaviour hai students ke saath inka😠
